target_customer: Data teams in large organizations with broken pipelines or slow change cycles
problem: Data teams scaling up face slow onboarding, hours of debugging because information is scattered, unclear downstream impact of changes and unclear ownership. ilumadata offered one workspace to design, version, validate, test and debug pipelines so less technical people could edit them.

founders.name: Luke Singham
founders.background_notes: Data platform engineer and data lead at Monzo, earlier at Palantir across commercial and government work, over 10 years in data, per the YC company page.

founders.name: Matt Sutton
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder on the YC launch post; no background published there.

competitors.name: Prophecy
competitors.what: Low-code data engineering platform with a visual interface that generates code
competitors.funding_then: US$25M Series A led by Insight Partners, announced January 2022

competitors.name: Ascend.io
competitors.what: Automated data pipeline orchestration with no, low and high code options
competitors.funding_then: About US$35M raised, reported April 2022 (one headline says US$31M)

technical_complexity.rationale: A cloud workspace combining visual pipeline design, versioning, validation, testing and lineage across a modern data stack is standard engineering with hard parts around integrations, for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Pipelines stored in the workspace could create lock in, but funded rivals such as Prophecy and Ascend had similar visual tooling.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source describes what incumbents did in response; the company went inactive.

market_need_then: The YC launch post cites slow onboarding taking days to weeks, hours of pipeline debugging and unclear data ownership at scale, drawn from the founder's experience at Monzo. No spend data was found.

branding.domain_note: Used ilumadata.io (YC page). That domain now redirects with a 301 to an unrelated site, so it is no longer controlled by the company.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and benefit led, for example ship 3x more analytics code with fewer errors

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community coverage of the brand was found. Search results for the name were crowded by similarly named companies such as Lumiata and ILUMA.

outcome_analysis: ilumadata was a two person London team in YC Summer 2022 building a workspace for data pipelines and is marked Inactive. The outcome search found no shutdown notice, post-mortem or acquisition, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty. No funding round was found, its original domain now redirects elsewhere, and funded rivals already offered low-code pipeline tooling at founding.
notes: No funding found in two searches (outcome and funding plus a Crunchbase/PitchBook cross-check); the Crunchbase page showed no figures. The YC launch post names no competitors. A loot-drop.io page calls the company a media analytics firm, which conflicts with YC and is ignored. Exit type is unknown because no shutdown source was found although YC marks it Inactive. Matt Sutton is a co-founder per the YC launch post.
